intent: Define the first algebraic rules for non-local NavT (Transport), including path-composition, topological distance dependence, and non-local residual thresholding.

non_local_composition.condition: recursive composition along a sequence of coupled neighbors

non_local_residual_rules.name: path_residual_accumulation_rule_v1
non_local_residual_rules.statement: The path residual delta_T_path = (NavT(i,j) ∘ NavT(j,k)) - NavT(i,k) accumulates along the chain; stability requires the total residual to remain bounded by a topology-dependent threshold Tau_T(path).

rules.name: no_non_local_transport_without_path_validity_v1
rules.statement: Non-local transport claims must show an admissible chain of local coupling neighbors and a bounded total transport residual.

rules.name: no_instantaneous_non_local_coupling_v1
rules.statement: Non-local interaction must propagate through intermediate NavT composition unless a verified non-local mechanism (e.g., long-range graph edge) is explicitly declared.

closure_progress: path-composition rule for non-local NavT defined
still_blocking: explicit threshold Tau_T per mechanism class
